sections.heading: Bottom-up estimates
sections.markdown:
**Sources (primary):** Q2-26 8-K/press release + financial supplement (SEC 2026-07-15); Q4-25 8-K (SEC 2026-01-15); SEC XBRL company facts (NetIncomeLoss, StockholdersEquity, EPS, shares); the macro regime memo 2026-10-03.

**FY25 actual (Q4-25 8-K):** NI $16,861M, EPS $10.21, net rev $70,645M, ROTCE 21.6%, ROE 16.6%; IS $33,080M / WM $31,754M / IM $6,525M; provision $349M; NII $10,046M; TBVPS $50.00; buybacks $4.6B.

**H1-26 actual (Q2-26 8-K):** NI $11,148M, EPS $6.90, ROTCE 26.8% YTD; Q2 net rev $21,348M: IS $11,040M (+44% y/y; Equity +69%, IB +58%, FICC +13%), WM $8,856M (+14%, NII $2,254M +18%), IM $1,646M; provision $98M; firm NII $2,780M; comp 38%; CET1 std 14.8%; TBVPS $53.18; common equity $106,579M; 1,571.9M shares; div $1.15/qtr.

**FY26E:** H2 tracks H1 with seasonal Q4 fade (Q4-25 $4,397M) → NI ~$21.5B, EPS ~$13.7. LOAD-BEARING #1: H1-26 actual + Q4 seasonality (Q2-26 8-K).
**FY27E (normalized):** IS −15% (~$37B), WM +8% (~$34.5B), IM +7% → net rev ~$78B; comp 41.5%, non-comp 26%, provision $1,300M (LOAD-BEARING #2: Q2-26 $98M vs FY25 $349M is below-cycle — normalize to FY25 run-rate, costs ~0.3-0.5pp ROE), tax 24% → NI ~$18.3B, EPS ~$11.9. **Sustainable ROE 17.5%, ROTCE 21.5%** (FY25's own delivered level; Q4-25 8-K).

**Mix-implied ROE through a flat curve (card Q1):** WM = 41% of H1-26 revenue at 29% segment ROE (Q2-26 supplement) — the stable leg; flat curve keeps WM NII supported (deposit beta <1, WM NII +18% y/y as policy rates rose). IS = 51% at a 26% boom ROE normalizes to ~14-16%. Weighted ≈ 19% pre-haircut → **~17.5% sustainable**.

**Earnings-quality gate:** provision/Q2 $98M below-cycle (optics-class — haircut applied, LOAD-BEARING #2). No manipulation-class flag; no related-party/VIE/structure flags (US domestic filer); accruals N/A (bank — provisioning trend used).

sections.markdown: Market narrative: MS's +43% run is a peak-cycle capital-markets boom — H1-26 trading records at ~3.6x tangible book into a hiking Fed — and the September de-rating as UST10y spiked to 5.24% is the start of the give-back.

sections.heading: Variant perception
sections.markdown:
**Market believes:** the mix is boom-cyclical (IS 51% of revenue), the 3.58x-TBV multiple has no cushion, and every GLOBAL bank this desk touched (SMFG-001/002, MUFG-001, JPM-001) died exactly this way — 4-for-4 KILL.
**Why wrong:** the pullback is RATES-driven, not fundamental — H1-26 ROTCE 26.8% (+5pp over FY25) came with WM ROE 29% and WM NII +18%; the $8.08T client-asset wealth franchise is compounding and now 41% of revenue, growing the stable share. But it is not mis-modeling the mechanism: at COE 10.24% (UST10y 5.24%, FRED 10-01, + USD ERP 5.0% mid-band), warranted P/BV (17.5−5)/(10.24−5) = 2.39x vs 2.81x traded; warranted P/TBV 3.15x vs 3.58x (run-rate ROTCE 24% → 3.6x ≈ fair). No re-rating gap — ~14-18% premium already paid (card Q2). A three-headline reader reaches this same view: no variant edge.
**What proves us wrong:** ROTCE ≥24% two more quarters with UST10y ≤5.0% — then the target is under-set and the run continues (rates, not earnings, are the whole question).

sections.heading: Disconfirming facts
sections.markdown:
1. H1-26 ROTCE 26.8% is trading-leg-flattered: IS +44% y/y vs WM +14% (Q2-26 8-K); FY25 delivered 21.6% on the same franchise (Q4-25 8-K) — ~5pp is cycle.
2. UST10y 5.24% (FRED DGS10 10-01), +47bp in one month; FOMC hiked 09-15/16, next 10-28/29 live (macro_regime fed_path marker): at COE 10.75% warranted P/TBV → ~2.9x vs 3.58x traded. MS is net-long rates/equity risk (trading inventory + fees marked to $8.08T assets); September's −8% already demonstrated the transmission (card Q3).
3. Provision $98M/Q2 vs $349M FY25 (Q2-26/Q4-25 8-Ks) — levels this thin are below-cycle; normalization costs ~0.3-0.5pp ROE the valuation has not paid for.
4. WM fees are marked to client assets (Q2-26 8-K): a 10% drawdown (CAUTIOUS regime live, DXY at 52w high) cuts the stable leg ~$0.8-1.0B/yr precisely as IS normalizes.
5. Q2-26 buybacks $1.5B at ~3.6x TBV per-share-BV dilutive (JPM-001 Revision #1): the ~2%/yr shrink is value-negative at this premium.

sections.heading: Pre-mortem
sections.markdown: It is July-2027, the position is down ~20%: the Oct-28/29 FOMC hiked or guided hawkish, UST10y cleared 5.5%, COE 10.75% drove warranted P/TBV to ~2.9x, and the 3.58x entry de-rated toward 3.0x as equity trading reverted toward FY25 run-rate — the mix-reversion my own numbers conceded (26.8%→21.6%). The momentum-crash failure (sharp reversal, no valuation cushion) materialized; the 2.1% net dividend cushioned nothing.
